{{Quote|In his mind, torture is an art form and almost a game: he seems to perceive his challenge to be to traverse the line of one's pain and endurance without going so far as to kill the person. Unfortunately, when he loses his little game, his prisoner does as well.|[[Tirranna]], on [[Mox Slosin]]|<ref name="AIR" />}}
The '''subjugation of Fitca''' was an action carried out by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Fitca system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The subjugation==
During the subjugation of Fitca, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Shanda Dok]] took part in the first [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] support wave on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fitca Prime]]. She was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and immediately taken before [[Mox Slosin]], an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] interrogator stationed in the [[Fitca system]].<ref name="AIR" />

Despite being one of the Empire's most effective interrogators, Slosin got too enthusiastic with her intense [[Torture/Legends|interrogation]]. Colonel Dok refused to betray the Alliance and, for her resolve, [[Death/Legends|died]] at Slosin's hands.<ref name="AIR" />

Eventually, the subjugation of Fitca Prime and its [[Star system/Legends|system]] was completed.<ref name="AIR" /><ref name="TCSWE" />

==Aftermath==
Following the successful subjugation of Fitca, Slosin was transferred to [[Urce]] and became a [[High Inquisitor]] in charge of the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]].<ref name="AIR" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], a report from the [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] described the murder of Colonel Dok as the worst case of Slosin's "overly sensitive" interrogations.<ref name="AIR" />
